分诊(session `session_01LrqnyLhY3kYBBRird4peBT`,2026-08-24):入决策箱(`needs-user-decision` + `domain:ui`)—— 去向由 #5927 裁决原文预定(B/C 两组「come back to the decision inbox with the renderer reading attached」),本卡即该回箱载体,8 条渲染器读数已附卡面。四棱卡面块如下(逐键读数以卡面正文为准,此处不复述)。

os-decision-facets

**一句话问题**:8 个「TS 声明」与「运行时校验器」各说各话的键,每个要一条「往哪边收敛」的裁决 —— 改哪边都会改变已发布校验器接受什么,所以按 #5927 的裁决逐键人工裁,不批量编辑。

**选项 × 真实代价**(按读数分三簇):
- **双边皆死簇(B1 `FormSchema.mode`、B2 `HeaderBarSchema.variant`)**:两套词表在该表面都无读点 —— 真正的选择不是「选哪边」而是「两边都撤(ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove)还是留着」。撤 = 公开面收缩,响亮;留 = 继续声明一个运行时不兑现的键。
- **镜子侧死簇(B4 `rowActions` 数组方言、B5 `Calendar` 的 string 方言、B6 `ChatbotSchema.body` 覆写、C1/C2 required 收紧)**:声明与运行代码同向、镜子独走 —— 收敛到声明侧即「镜子回归声明」,改的是校验器接受集(C1/C2 是放宽:今天类型检查通过、渲染正常的 `{type:"combobox"}` 在 parse 时被拒)。
- **分层词表簇(B3 `FilterFieldSchema.operators`)**:两套拼写都活、在不同层 —— 要裁的是「authoring 面说哪层的话」,且渲染器根本不读该键,附带一个「它是否该 authorable」的 ADR-0049 半问。

**四棱**:
① **实际业务拉动**:C1/C2 是实测的 author 可撞面(合法 authoring 被 parse 拒);其余各簇今天无用户撞上,但每个都是元数据作者的潜在假承诺。
② **项目长远合理性**:163 对镜子的 `KnownDrift` 台账 shrink-only,每裁一键台账缩一行 —— 方向就是清零;不裁则台账永久背着 13 行。
③ **防 AI 犯错**:声明≠强制的键正是 AI 生成元数据最容易自信写错的表面;收敛(或 ADR-0049 撤除)每一键都在缩小这个温床。C1/C2 反向提醒:收紧 required 会让 AI 既有产出当场变红 —— 变红是对的,但要在 changeset 里说清。
④ **创业阶段不扩散**:全部 8 键都是收敛/删减方向,无新增能力面;双边皆死簇走撤除是净减法。

**推荐**(逐键,读数支撑在正文):B1、B2 → **双侧 ADR-0049 撤除候选**(转 enforce-or-remove 通道);B4 → 撤镜子的数组方言;B5 → 撤镜子 string 方言,`range` 形状缺口另立小卡;B6 → 撤镜子覆写、回归 `BaseSchema.body` 槽语义(API 义已有 `requestBody`);C1、C2 → 镜子改 `.optional()` 对齐声明与运行代码;B3 → **建议单独裁**:authoring 面说 UI 层词表(`is_empty/is_not_empty`),query-AST 拼写留转换层,渲染器不读 `operators` 的半问转 ADR-0049 通道。**置信缺口**:B1/B2 的「无读点」是本仓 grep,未测 hotcrm/真实部署是否有 authored 实例(撤除 PR 按撤除纪律先跑消费面清点);逐键实施均改已发布校验器 ⇒ 对应 PR 走契约档复核。

**低摩擦裁决格式**:回「按推荐」即可整批落地;或逐键「B3 改 X」式点名覆盖,未点名的按推荐走。

Maintainer ruling (2026-08-25, in-session batch adjudication, batch 2; verbatim: 「其他同意」 — the whole per-key table accepted as recommended). Ruling philosophy: **align every end to the measured live side; keys nobody reads retire (ADR-0049)**. Per key:

| key | ruled disposition |
|---|---|
| B1 `FormSchema.mode` | both vocabularies zero-reader ⇒ **retire** (enforce-or-remove route, both sides) |
| B2 `HeaderBarSchema.variant` | zero-reader ⇒ **retire** |
| B3 `FilterFieldSchema.operators` | the key itself has no reader on this surface ⇒ **retire on this surface only**; the two spellings living in authoring/query-AST layers are NOT touched |
| B4 `DataTableSchema.rowActions` | renderer implements boolean ⇒ mirror aligns to **boolean**, arrays reject loudly |
| B5 `CalendarSchema.value`/`defaultValue` | contract accepts **ISO string** (the only JSON-authorable form; Date stays legal for programmatic use), renderer parses to Date so authored values actually preselect — behaviour fix |
| B6 `ChatbotSchema.body` | mirror override unread ⇒ **delete the override**, restoring the inherited slot meaning |
| C7 `ComboboxSchema.options` | renderer tolerates absence ⇒ mirror goes **optional** (three ends aligned) |
| C8 `CommandSchema.groups` | same ⇒ **optional** |

Claim-time obligations ruled with it: re-run the zero-reader greps (B1/B2/B3/B6) against current `main` before editing — the verdicts above ride the card's measurements and stale-premise discipline applies; retirements follow the recorded retirement route (tombstone/prescription per house pattern), not bare deletion.

State transition: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` (this comment is the authoritative record if the label lags). Lane `domain:ui`, one claim, per-key commits. Clause-②: yes (C-group widens the published accept set, B4 narrows it, B5 changes runtime behaviour) — contract-review tier at dispatch.

## 转录：#6638 的生产侧读数，支持已裁的 B4

#6638 独立重填了本卡 **B4 行**（`DataTableSchema.rowActions`），已按重复关闭并指向本卡。它带来一条本卡 B4 原本**没有**的读数，转录于此以免随卡关闭而丢失。

本卡 B4 只测了**消费侧**（`data-table.tsx`：`rowActions = false` 默认、`{rowActions && (`、`(rowActions ? 1 : 0)`，从不索引数组元素）。#6638 测了**生产侧**：

```
packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx —— rowActions: !!(inlineEditable && hasActions)
```

⇒ seam 的**两端都是布尔**，只有 zod 镜像是 `z.array(z.any()).optional()`。

### 这对已裁的处置意味着什么

2026-08-25 的裁决对 B4 是：*「renderer implements boolean ⇒ mirror aligns to **boolean**, arrays reject loudly」*。⭐ 新读数**同向加强**它 —— 原判据是「消费者按布尔读」，现在是「生产者按布尔写、消费者按布尔读、镜像独走」。⛔ 不改变处置，只是把它的证据基从一端变成两端。

顺带对该裁决的 claim-time 义务有帮助：裁决要求「B1/B2/B3/B6 落地前对 current `main` 重跑 zero-reader grep」。B4 不在那份重跑名单里（它不是 zero-reader 类），但这条生产侧读数是 2026-08-28 在 `38a123cac` 上测的，比卡面原读数新。

⛔ 本席不裁、不派发，仅转录证据。本卡 `pm:queue` + `domain:ui` 维持不变 —— 已核 2026-08-25 那条裁决记录里写明了 `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` 的状态转移是**刻意**的，不是漏标。

## Dispatch check: ruled ✅, but **held on the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` quota** — recording the live blocker so the next seat does not re-derive it

`domain:ui` PM seat, session `session_01EMrWaQw3XS5DxTHxp4yRyC`. ⛔ Nothing claimed, graded or relabelled. Read-only.

I evaluated this card for dispatch tonight and am **not** taking it. The reason is not in the ruling's substance — it is in the ruling's own last line:

> `Clause-②`: **yes** (C-group widens the published accept set, B4 narrows it, B5 changes runtime behaviour) — contract-review tier at dispatch.

⚠️ **That tier is quota-exhausted right now.** Measured tonight: three consecutive 429s from the `claude-fable-5` reviewer (~00:05Z, ~00:33Z, ~01:37Z), and PR #7577 has been sitting held on it since, with green CI and no merge conflict. ⛔ I will not substitute a different model tier to get past it — that is precisely what the gate exists to prevent — so a PR opened against this card today could be built but not landed.

⇒ **Status, precisely:** ruled ✅ · per-key dispositions complete ✅ · claim-time obligations stated ✅ · **gated on a review budget that is not a GitHub surface and is UNMEASURED-BY-ME as to when it reopens.** I can only report that it refused three times tonight, not that it is still shut. The moment it answers, this card is dispatch-ready with no further measurement.

### ⭐ Why I am commenting at all: the card reads as unruled from its body

The title says *"8 zod-mirror drifts **need a per-key ruling**"* and the body ends with the eight readings and no dispositions. The ruling is [comment `5406213903`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/6033#issuecomment-5406213903), 2026-08-25 — ten days ago — and it explicitly anticipated this: *"this comment is the authoritative record if the label lags."*

I dismissed three cards tonight by reading only their bodies (#7077 and #6964 were both ruled/graded in comments hours earlier; #7205 was ruled 2026-09-02). Reading threads instead turned two of them into same-hour dispatches. This card is the same shape in a third direction: **the thread reveals both that it IS ruled and that it is NOT dispatchable** — the body would have told me neither.

⇒ Recorded on #6653 as the general finding; noted here so the next seat evaluating this card gets the live blocker in one read instead of re-running my evening.

### One claim-time obligation worth keeping visible

The ruling requires re-running the zero-reader greps for **B1 / B2 / B3 / B6** against current `main` before editing — stale-premise discipline, because those four verdicts ride the card's own 2026-08-24 measurements on `d2fb6efb4`. ⚠️ That is not a formality here: I dispatched two slices of a different card tonight off inventories that had gone stale underneath them, and **both were void** — one measured a namespace deleted three weeks earlier, the other would have deleted 30 live keys. A ten-day-old zero deserves the re-run the ruling already ordered.

⭐ Note also that B4's evidence base has since strengthened rather than drifted: the transcription above records the **producer** side (`ObjectGrid.tsx` writes `rowActions: !!(inlineEditable && hasActions)`), so both ends of that seam are boolean and only the mirror walks alone. That row's disposition is unaffected; its footing is now two-sided.
